findings.summary: With the self-employed (עצמאים) option, years 1-5 show only empty bars and no result, so part of the reader's question goes unanswered. The switch does respond, so this is not problem 1, and it says nothing about a tax line or the chart jumping, so it is not problem 2.
A different column (securities account, 25,725) shows a big number where the fund's figure should be, so a reader could easily take it as the 4-year answer and decide wrongly.
The round back-to-top button covers the end of one column label. This is a minor visual overlap.
The calculator assumes 7% a year and says this is an assumption, not a forecast. Some readers may still read it as a promised return, but the page does disclose it.
The intro says 3 years is enough at retirement age, but the calculator cannot model that case. This is a gap between the text and the tool, but the text itself gives the answer.
The dark page with grey text is tiring to read. This is a matter of comfort and taste.
